eoe.text: The Sunstar Free Company was dispatched by the Palatinate to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
Its soldiers clashed with the Monoist boarders, and Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company later accepted Alpharael's challenge.
A Free Company ship then arrived at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies, and the Free Company swept the town with drones and infantry while the Kav resisted by sabotage and obstruction.
Haliya, who had joined the Company and become Vondam's squire, deserted after the atrocity, and Vondam formally degraded her and cast her out of the Free Company.
